_comment: BACKLOG §M 2b(y): HUNTED SEEDS of the skill suite -- extra games of a squad (with its star_hires.json hire) that are known to exercise a skill too rare for seeds 1-20. scripts/sksweep.py gates each range as its own verdict '<ed> <squad>@<range>' (only when the sweep runs the suite's 1-20), scripts/skill_ledger.py jobs('skill') replays the same ranges, so the cert and the ledger see the same games. Found with the Rust-only bench (FFB_BENCH_GREP=<report substring> or D:/ffb_scratch_it13/seedtouch.py for skill touches) on ffb-parity-sp20b.exe, then gated against Java. FRAGILE BY NATURE: any engine/agent change that moves the RNG stream re-rolls these games -- if a ledger shows the skill missing again, re-hunt and replace the seed (never pad with wide ranges). bb2020 chaos_sk 141 + 176: Guffle Pussmaw's Quick Bite (141: skillUse quickBite + quickBite injury, armour broken). bb2020 slann_sk 193 / slann_fumbbl_sk 218: Dribl and Drull's A Sneaky Pair +1 injury actually applied (injuryModifiers names it), the bb2020 injury modifier ported in 2b(x). bb2025 gnome_sk 21: Rowana Forestfoot's Bounding Leap (skillUse passJumpWithoutModifiers + leapRoll), found on ffb-parity-bl2.exe, gated 2b(f).
